## What changes

_One or two sentences. Link the issue if there is one._

## Checklist

- [ ] Every new empirical claim cites a DOI or stable URL and carries a grade tag
- [ ] What studies measured is kept separate from what their authors inferred
- [ ] No invented numerical coefficients; formal components stay symbolic
- [ ] `make check` passes (lint, ledger freshness, tests)
- [ ] `make claims` was run if the paper changed
- [ ] `make dois` was run if references were added
- [ ] An ADR was added if a modelling decision changed
